name: com.poloniacitizenship/citizenship
title: Polonia Citizenship
description: Polish citizenship by descent: eligibility check, key facts and a free case review.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Facts about Polish citizenship by descent as Polonia Citizenship handles it: who qualifies, dual citizenship, timeline, cost, what we do, and the main pages.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Our public answers to common questions about Polish citizenship by descent (documents, travel, dual citizenship, timeline, cost, family situations). Pass the person's question to get the closest answers, or leave it empty for the full list.

question.description: The person's question in their own words (optional).

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Quick read of whether a family line qualifies for confirmation of Polish citizenship by descent: which generation the Polish ancestor is, and when they left Poland. Gives the same preliminary read as the eligibility check on https://poloniacitizenship.com/check. Ask the person for each answer; use "not_sure" when they don't know. The result is preliminary: our team confirms every case.

ancestor.description: Closest Polish ancestor in the direct line: parent, grandparent, great_grandparent, further (further back, or an aunt / uncle / cousin), or not_sure.

departure_time.description: When that ancestor left Poland: before_1920, 1920_to_1951, after_1951, or not_sure.

tools.name: start_case
tools.description: Sends the person's details to Polonia Citizenship for a free eligibility review, exactly like the form on https://poloniacitizenship.com/check. We read the family line and reply by email; a confirmation email arrives shortly. Only call this after the person has clearly asked to send their details to Polonia Citizenship, and set confirmed_by_person to true. Never guess an email address.

email.description: The email address where we should send the review.

family_story.description: What they know about their Polish ancestor and the family line: names, places, dates, when the family left, documents they have.

phone.description: Phone number, only if the person offers it.

ancestor.description: Closest Polish ancestor in the direct line: parent, grandparent, great_grandparent, further (further back, or an aunt / uncle / cousin), or not_sure.

departure_time.description: When that ancestor left Poland: before_1920, 1920_to_1951, after_1951, or not_sure.

email_confirmed.description: Set to true only if we flagged the email as possibly mistyped and the person confirmed it is correct.

confirmed_by_person.description: True only when the person explicitly asked to send these details to Polonia Citizenship.
